results.rationale: Consistency: state borders, coastline and white exterior are preserved. Instruction: all four requested colors are used to fill the map, but many adjacent states share a color. Knowledge: California/Nevada and numerous neighboring green states violate the different-colors adjacency requirement. Quality: clean, coherent filled regions and visible boundaries.

Consistency: room layout and chair pose remain recognizable, but a person is added behind the chair and wood grain and surrounding floor details change. Instruction: the missing chair leg and disconnected support remain; human legs are added instead of completing the chair. Quality: realistic lighting and materials, but the unsupported wooden brace and incomplete chair assembly create an obvious structural problem.
